test_so3_exp_map_determinant: test that so3_exp_map produces rotation matrices with determinants equal to 1
test_so3_hat_cross_product: test that hat operator matrix product equals cross product of two 3D vectors
test_so3_log_map_roundtrip: test that so3_log_map and so3_exp_map are inverses of each other
test_so3_relative_angle: test that so3_relative_angle computes correct angles between two batches of rotation matrices
test_so3_rotation_angle_cos_bound: test that so3_rotation_angle returns finite gradients when cos_bound is set
